1. Heard Ms. R. D. Mozumdar, learned counsel for the appellant.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the Oriental Insurance Company Limited impugning the judgment and award dated 06.12.2024, passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 2, Kamrup(M), in MAC Case No. 2743/2019 whereby the appellant was directed to pay compensation amount of Rs.15,18,786.75/- along with interest at the rate of 9% per annum to the claimants/respondents.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No. 2, Kamrup(M)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. I have gone through the grounds stated in the memo of appeal and have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant.
4. This appeal is admitted.

5. Let the records of MAC Case No. 2743/2019 be called for from the Page No.# 3/3 concerned tribunal.
6.
The Registry to take steps for requisitioning the aforesaid records.

7. Issue notice to the respondents.
8.
The appellant shall take steps for issuance of notice upon the respondents by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order, returnable 28th of May, 2026.
